name: Bright Asogwa
headline: SDR @Demandive | We make SaaS & B2B founders the go-to authority in their category and add 20-30 sales calls a month.

sections.bio:
My first 3 months in sales, I booked 1 meeting.

I thought I was the problem. Turned out prospects were doing their research after I reached out and finding nothing. No content, dead LinkedIn, no proof the company existed beyond a logo. The curiosity died before the conversation could go anywhere. I got fired shortly after.

That experience taught me something most SDRs find out too late. Outbound without authority behind it is just noise. The best message in the world falls flat if there is nothing to back it up when a prospect goes looking.

Since then I have built outbound systems from scratch at multiple startups, no playbook, no leads handed to me. I prospect daily using Apollo, Sales Navigator, and HubSpot, write my own sequences, and manage conversations from first message to booked call.

Right now I work as an appointment setter at Demandive, where I run LinkedIn outreach for B2B SaaS and AI founders who are building the kind of authority that makes every conversation easier to close.

If you are a founder trying to turn LinkedIn attention into booked calls, or an SDR leader building out a pipeline function, send me a message.

posts.text:
Every salesperson has this moment



You've got the email. You've got the title. You still don't know what to say

So you default to "hope this finds you well" and hit send anyway

Went looking for a founder's contact today, expected just an email back

But FullEnrich pulled his whole career alongside it, past companies he's built and exited, what he's running now, where he's based

If not for that, I would've spent another chunk of time hunting for a decent first line myself

First line got easier to write. Not because I tried harder, but because I actually had something real to say

Most outreach doesn't fail from bad targeting. It fails from having nothing real to open with

#FullEnrichPartner

P.S. Still giving the selfie challenge more time. Day 2 and still counting Elisa Marten 😅

Luke 6:31 hit differently this week

"Just as you want men to do to you, do the same way to them."

I have been receiving a lot of cold DMs from fellow salespeople lately

Some I could not understand. Some had no reason for me to reply. Some looked good but were not useful to me at all. One person messaged me clearly thinking I was a founder. I went back and checked my profile twice to see what I had said wrong 🤣 

Then I asked myself something uncomfortable

Am I doing the same thing to my prospects?

That one question changed how I write every message now

Before I hit send, I ask: if this landed in my inbox right now would I reply to it?

Not would I be impressed? 
Not does it follow the framework?
Would I actually reply?

If the answer is no I rewrite it.

You can't complain about bad outreach in your inbox and then send the same thing to someone else

I learned that the hard way. I don't want you making the same mistake

P.S. Still giving the selfie challenge more time. Yesterday's breakdown showed it is working. Just needs more runway

The long-awaited video is here Oliver Nourouzi, Ashlee S., Elisa Marten, Tom Morgan, Victor Ugwuoke, Micheal Akinbowale, Karen Katsumata, Praise Olaniyi, Josh Etim 

Day to Day breakdown of my 7 days selfie challange 

Check it out and let me know what you think

Yesterday I asked if YOU wanted to see the selfie challenge results

And you all asked for it. So here we go

7 Days selfie challenge 

12,469 impressions

 1,970 total followers. Up 11% in 7 days

 439 reactions. 236 comments

 59% are people who were not even following me

Three things I did every single day:

Posted by 8am

Commented on other people's posts

Reposted during the day then deleted at night

Am I saying this is the formula? No. But these are my real numbers and if you feel like trying you are good to go 

Shoutout to Elisa Marten for pushing me to try this. And to Josh Etim, Praise Olaniyi and Victoria Kooro for the support. If i don't mention your name am sorry, but i really apprecaite you all 

Should you try the selfie challenge yourself?
